rationale: The original short thesis remains fully intact after 6 minutes in the trade. Price tested the 5-minute 9-EMA resistance zone around $809.01–$809.64 on low 1-minute volume and was rejected back down to $807.62, remaining well below both the 9-EMA and session VWAP ($816.02).
